meta.title: Sonny Angel Full Timeline
meta.counting_rule: An entry stands only when a source consulted at build time verifies the series exists. Evidence A is an official Sonny Angel or Dreams source, B is an established collector or retailer reference that gives a year, C is an official list where the year is grouped or approximate and is labelled as such. Entries with no year in the source are shown as Year not stated, never guessed.
meta.scale_note: Dreams and its stores describe the brand at very different counts over time, from more than 500 varieties on the USA store to more than 650 kinds on the global site and more than 1,300 variations in newer brand copy. Those are the brand's own claims about individual figures, not a count of series, and this timeline counts series and release lines only.
